name: Innovex Electric Kettle (2L)
description: 2 litre Innovex stainless steel electric kettle with 1500W power, auto cut-off and 1-year warranty. Fast boiling for everyday use.
details: The Innovex 2L Electric Kettle is made with a stainless steel body for fast and reliable boiling. It features automatic power cut-off, anti-dry protection, a 360° swivel base, power indicator, pull-up lid and an anti-scalding handle. Ideal for tea, coffee and daily kitchen use in Sri Lankan homes. Backed by a 1-year warranty.
